name: YCOE Work-Based Learning (B-Unbound)
what_you_do: You pick a career interest. Yolo County Office of Education staff match you with a vetted mentor. The mentor works at a business, agency or nonprofit. You complete about 60 hours of hands-on learning.
who_can_apply: Students in Yolo County. Start through your school College and Career Center or counselor, or email CCR@ycoe.org. Age or grade limits were not stated on the page.
pay_detail: Stipend up to $500 on successful completion
how_to_apply: Tell your school College and Career Center or counselor, or email CCR@ycoe.org.
notes: B-Unbound is the online platform for finding opportunities (interviews, tours, job shadowing, projects, internships). Placement depends on available mentors, so ask early. The stipend is paid after you finish the requirements. Email: CCR@ycoe.org. Paid work for people under 18 in California needs a Permit to Employ and Work. See permit.html?state=ca for the exact permit and steps.
